title: The external test runner still retains a subprocess fallback
observed_need: Run a suite and its entries while preserving one compiler/runtime session, shared provenance, and bounded setup state.
current_language_behavior: mncs-embed exposes a typed retained Session::call_batch API. The native runner compiles once, opens one session, executes one batch, and emits typed TestResult/CheckResult projections with fallback=false.
why_insufficient: The compiler/toolchain process and external JSON file publication remain Rust bootstrap boundaries; direct MNCS-to-MNCS module calls across separate applications are not yet exposed as a general userland service.
minimal_reproducer: A current mncs-test-self run records execution.mode=retained-embed-batch, batch_size=6, session.reused_session=true; remove the shared library to reproduce the explicit subprocess-per-test fallback.
desired_direction: A versioned batch/session execution API that keeps native values and fixtures in one bounded runtime while preserving per-test identity and isolation controls.
workaround: The native CLI owns the one bootstrap compiler invocation and retained session. Python preserves an independent oracle only through bin/mncs-test-compat; there is no silent fallback.
